Overall UI Score
26 findings 5 critical
While visually appealing and clearly identifying the product, the page suffers from critical usability and accessibility issues, most notably the absence of a direct call-to-action for the featured product and several contrast and navigation problems.
Top Priority
The most important issue is the complete lack of an explicit call-to-action button or link immediately associated with the prominently featured 'Miles&Smiles' product, significantly hindering user engagement and conversion.
